data.content: ["Matagorda offers free beach walks and low-cost accommodations perfect for your tight budget, with excellent outdoor recreation that matches your group's nature-first priorities.", "Bisti/De-Na-Zin Wilderness delivers exceptional free outdoor exploration with minimal costs and stunning natural landscapes that align perfectly with your budget-conscious, nature-focused trip.", "Bonneville Salt Flats provides one of the most unique free outdoor experiences in the region with virtually no entrance fees or required paid attractions, ideal for budget-maximizing nature lovers.", "Devils Tower National Monument combines iconic free outdoor access, scenic nature activities, and minimal costs, making it the perfect budget-friendly destination for your group's outdoor priorities.", "Albuquerque offers walkable neighborhoods with affordable food options and free outdoor activities like Old Town exploration and nature trails, providing the best balance of budget-conscious dining and urban nature access."]
